definitions.gloss: House of Councillors; upper house of the Japanese Diet
definitions.explanation: The upper house of the National Diet of Japan. Members serve six-year terms, with half elected every three years. It has 248 seats.

examples.japanese: {参議院|さんぎいん}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The House of Councillors election is next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{参議院|さんぎいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill was rejected by the House of Councillors.

examples.japanese: {参議院|さんぎいん}{議員|ぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{任期|にんき}→任期：11553_ninki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六年|ろくねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半数|はんすう}→半数：30503_hansuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{改選|かいせん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Members of the House of Councillors serve six-year terms, with half being re-elected every three years.

notes:
USAGE:
{参議院|さんぎいん} is the upper house of Japan's bicameral ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ (National Diet). It is sometimes called the "house of careful deliberation" because it reviews legislation passed by the lower house.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参議院|さんぎいん}{選挙|せんきょ} (House of Councillors election)
- {参議院|さんぎいん}{議員|ぎいん} (member of the House of Councillors)
- {参議院|さんぎいん}{本会議|ほんかいぎ} (plenary session of the House of Councillors)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Japan's Diet consists of two houses: the ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧ (House of Representatives, lower house) and the {参議院|さんぎいん} (House of Councillors, upper house). The lower house has greater legislative power.
